newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia upholds death for three in Mubarak attack.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia upholds death for three in Mubarak attack.

text.p: Ethiopia's Federal High Court upheld on Thursday death sentences against three Egyptian gunmen found guilty of attempting to kill Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in 1995, the state Ethiopian News Agency said.
The three were found guilty and sentenced to death last September for trying to assassinate the Egyptian president as he arrived for an Organisation of African Unity summit in Addis Ababa.
Mubarak escaped unhurt when gunmen fired on his convoy. The three were also found guilty of killing two Ethiopian policemen, wounding seven civilians and smuggling weapons into Ethiopia.
Ethiopian authorities said 11 members of a Moslem fundamentalist group were in the plot to kill Mubarak and two of the men directed the failed operation from neighbouring Sudan.
Five of the gunmen were killed in a shootout and Ethiopia accused Sudan of harbouring the other three and has lobbied for sanctions against Khartoum, which has denied sheltering them.
